newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks nudge lower, new Ibex firms sink.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks nudge lower, new Ibex firms sink.

text.p: MADRID, July 1 (Reuter) 0825 GMT - Madrid stocks were slightly lower in early trade on Tuesday, with dividend payments weighing on the indices, dealers said. * General index down 0.05 points, 0.01 percent, to 600.57 * Ibex-35 down 13.89 points 0.2 percent, to 6,870.67 * New Ibex entries Viscofan, and metals firms Tubacex and Asturiana del Zinc were sharply lower on their first day's trade within the blue chip index. Viscofan off 1.3 percent to 3,400 pesetas, Asturiana down 1.12 percent to 3,085 pesetas and Tubacex down 1.19 percent to 500 pesetas. * Dividend payments today include Acerinox and utilities Iberdrola, Sevillana, Fecsa and Fenosa. * Endesa gains 220 pesetas to 13,590, pays dividend next week.

Dealers said the bourse was likely to remain relatively subdued ahead of this afternoon's U.S. Federal Open Market Committee. Market consensus expects no rate change, but traders will be on guard just in case.
Short-term the outlook in Spain was seen somewhat uncertain, although most consider that prices are well-underpinned and there are good possibilities of further gains.
